title: Why Is a Day on Venus Longer Than Its Year?
topic: Why a day on Venus is longer than a year on Venus
description: Discover how Venus takes 243 Earth days to rotate once while completing its orbit around the Sun in just 225 days. Learn how its dense, fast-moving atmosphere exerts a powerful atmospheric drag that slows its spin. Subscribe and follow us for more.
